name: World Forum of Accountants (WOFA) 2026
organiser: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
venue_name: Sai Priya Beach Resort / Beachside Convention Arena, Rushikonda
audience: Leaders, professionals, academicians, regulators and stakeholders from the accounting and finance fraternity (per wofa.icai.org)
footfall_text: Sponsors can present to "5000+ global delegates" (WOFA corporate sponsorship page; organiser claim)
exhibit_options: Standalone exhibition stall: 9 m2 INR 5,00,000; 6 m2 INR 3,00,000. Corporate sponsorship (each with stall space; 18% GST extra): Title 200 lakh (120 m2), Lead 100 lakh, Titanium 75 lakh, Platinum 50 lakh, Gold 30 lakh, Silver 15 lakh, Bronze 10 lakh, Pearl 7.5 lakh (9 m2). Separate CA-firm participation tiers from 2.5 lakh (6 m2). Source: wofa.icai.org/corporate-sponsorship and /opportunities
why_fit: ICAI's flagship global forum with a sponsor exhibition area; the cheapest standalone stall puts Vyapar in front of thousands of CAs at one venue
organiser_contact: Sponsorship: wofasponsorship@icai.in; WOFA Secretariat, ICAI Bhawan, New Delhi, +91 11 3011 0487

name: 51st Regional Conference of EIRC of ICAI
organiser: Eastern India Regional Council (EIRC) of ICAI
venue_name: Biswa Bangla Exhibition Centre, New Town (Rajarhat)
audience: ICAI members (CAs), non-member guests, CA firms and study circles; 12 structured CPE hours
footfall_text: "5000+ Number of Delegates", "100+ Number of Speakers", "50+ Number of Sponsors" (conference page; organiser claim)
exhibit_options: Stalls (GST extra): Super Premium 3x3 m with TV INR 2 lakh; Premium 2x2 m INR 1.25 lakh; Normal 1x1 m INR 70,000; table space INR 60,000; kiosk INR 50,000; standee INR 30,000; kit insertion INR 2 lakh. Sponsorships INR 7.5-35 lakh (Title 35 lakh incl. 3 premium stalls and a main speaking slot). Per the EIRC sponsorship brochure
why_fit: Largest CA gathering in East India, with priced stall options; the conference page already shows Vyapar TaxOne as an EIRC 'Annual Sponsor' and Tally as 'Technology Partner'
source_name: EIRC of ICAI - 51st Regional Conference page and sponsorship brochure

name: 40th Regional Conference of WIRC of ICAI - "Divya Drushti: Vidhya, Vision and Value"
organiser: Western India Regional Council (WIRC) of ICAI
audience: Chartered Accountants of the Western region (WIRC is ICAI's largest regional council); sessions on income tax, GST, practice and AI
exhibit_options: Sponsorship tiers shown on the site (Platinum, Gold, Supporting partners); prices not published. Current partners include Anand Rathi (Platinum), Vyapar TaxOne and Zoho (Gold), Taxmann AI and others (Supporting)
why_fit: Largest ICAI region's flagship conference in Mumbai; Vyapar TaxOne is already listed as a Gold Partner, so coordinate with that team for a partner-recruitment presence
source_name: WIRC 40th Regional Conference site - Program Schedule

name: NIRC Regional Conference 2026 - "Navodaya: A Salute to CA Profession"
organiser: Northern India Regional Council (NIRC) of ICAI
venue_name: Manekshaw Centre Auditorium, Parade Road, Delhi Cantonment
audience: Chartered Accountants of the Northern region; technical sessions plus celebrity speakers (B Praak, Sunil Grover, Kumar Vishwas)
why_fit: The North's flagship CA gathering in Delhi; worth asking NIRC about stall or sponsorship slots
source_name: NIRC of ICAI - Regional Conference 2026 page

name: 58th Regional Conference of SIRC of ICAI - DAKSHA (last edition)
organiser: Southern India Regional Council (SIRC) of ICAI
month_hint: Usually August. 57th: 22-23 Aug 2025, Chennai; 58th: 7-8 Aug 2026, Guntur. 59th (likely Aug 2027) not yet announced
audience: Chartered Accountants of the Southern region; the AP Finance and Commercial Taxes Minister and the ICAI President attended the 58th
footfall_text: 57th edition (Chennai, 2025) was expected to draw "over 3,500 delegates" (Dinamalar report; organiser claim)
why_fit: South India's largest annual CA gathering; the next edition falls inside the Nov 2026 - Sep 2027 window
source_name: ICAI photo gallery - 58th Regional Conference of SIRC

name: 46th Regional Conference of CIRC of ICAI
organiser: Central India Regional Council (CIRC) of ICAI
month_hint: Listed as an upcoming event on circ.icai.org; date and city not yet published
audience: Chartered Accountants of the Central region (MP, Rajasthan, UP, Chhattisgarh and others)
why_fit: The fifth ICAI regional conference; watch for dates and ask CIRC about stalls
source_name: CIRC of ICAI - 46th Regional Conference page

name: AIFTP 29th National Tax Convention
organiser: All India Federation of Tax Practitioners (AIFTP), Northern Zone
audience: Tax practitioners, advocates, CAs and GST/income-tax professionals from across India; AIFTP has 'over 11,000 members across 32 States and 3 Union Territories' (per the AIFTP President's communique)
footfall_text: The previous (28th) convention in Bengaluru, Dec 2025, was attended by "more than 889 delegates from across the country" (itatonline report; organiser claim)
exhibit_options: The 28th convention had dedicated Exhibition and Sponsorship committees (per its delegate brochure); prices not published. Delegate fee at the 28th: INR 5,000 early bird
why_fit: AIFTP's flagship annual convention; draws GST and income-tax practitioners, not just CAs
organiser_contact: Secretary General Adv. G. Baskar, 9444061639, gbaskaradvocate@gmail.com (listed for member queries in AIFTP Times)

name: AIFTP Two Day Golden Jubilee Zonal Tax Conference (Eastern Zone)
organiser: All India Federation of Tax Practitioners (AIFTP), Eastern Zone
audience: Tax practitioners and CAs of AIFTP's Eastern Zone; includes a zonal awards function
why_fit: Zonal tax-practitioner gathering in Odisha, a less-covered region

name: BCAS 60th Members' Residential Refresher Course (Diamond Jubilee) - "Beyond Numbers"
venue_name: Hotel Hyatt Regency, Ashram Road, Riverfront
audience: BCAS member Chartered Accountants (BCAS says it has 'membership & subscribers exceeding 12,000' across 400+ cities); chief guest: Gujarat Deputy CM Harsh Sanghavi
exhibit_options: No stall or sponsor details in the brochure. Delegate fee: Rs. 19,500 + GST (non-resident); only 10 non-residential seats for Ahmedabad locals. Vyapar TaxOne (Formerly Suvit) is listed under 'Friends of BCAS' on bcasonline.org
why_fit: BCAS's flagship RRC; senior practising CAs from across India, a small residential format suited to networking
source_name: BCAS - 60th Members' RRC event page and brochure

name: BCAS 31st International Tax and Finance Conference
audience: Chartered Accountants focused on international tax and finance (BCAS marquee annual event)
why_fit: BCAS marquee event with senior CAs; weaker fit because of the international-tax focus

name: The Chamber of Tax Consultants - 15th Residential Refresher Course on GST
organiser: The Chamber of Tax Consultants (CTC), Mumbai - Indirect Taxes Committee
audience: GST professionals and practitioners from across the country (CTC calls it 'one of the most prestigious and eagerly awaited gatherings of GST professionals')

why_fit: Specialist GST practitioners: the people who advise SMBs on billing and GST compliance

organiser: The Chamber of Tax Consultants (CTC), Mumbai
audience: Tax professionals from across India; CTC calls it 'one of the country's most sought-after residential tax conference'
exhibit_options: No sponsor or stall details published. Delegate fee: members INR 25,000-29,000 (double) / 40,000-44,000 (single) + GST, depending on registration window

source_name: The Chamber of Tax Consultants - upcoming events (ctconline.org)

name: GSTPAM 51st Residential Refresher Course
organiser: The Goods and Services Tax Practitioners' Association of Maharashtra (GSTPAM; formerly the Sales Tax Practitioners' Association of Maharashtra, STPAM)
audience: GST and sales-tax practitioners who are GSTPAM members (Maharashtra-based association)
why_fit: The main residential event of Maharashtra's GST-practitioner association; members serve trader and SMB clients directly

name: KSCAA Annual Conference (36th edition, 2024 - last edition found)
month_hint: Usually March (35th: 17-18 Mar 2023; 36th: March 2024). No 2026 or 2027 dates found on kscaa.com
audience: Chartered Accountants of Karnataka; KSCAA had 'more than 3600 members' (2023 sponsorship brochure)
footfall_text: 36th edition: "Over 900 members registered for the conference" (KSCAA President's Message, March 2024); 2023 brochure: "expected to draw footprints of more than 1500 delegates" (organiser claims)
exhibit_options: 2023 tariff (35th edition): exhibition stall Pavilion INR 2,00,000 / Premium 1,00,000 / Regular 50,000; sponsorship Main 15 lakh, Co-sponsor 9 lakh, Day 4 lakh, Delegate/Hospitality/Cultural 3 lakh. The brochure lists 'Software Product Companies' and 'Computer Hardware' among target sponsors

name: Samvaada 2026 - Karnataka State-level CA Conference (last edition)

exhibit_options: Sponsorship available through an enquiry form ('ICAI Bengaluru team will reach out with sponsorship options and the brochure'); no prices published
